include_directories(
    BEFORE include
    ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include/reactos/drivers/ndisuio)

# wlanconf.exe is all Rust (wlanconf-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/wlanconf-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# wlanconf.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/wlanconf-rust/src/wlanconf/wlanconf.rs)
add_cargo_module(wlanconf wlanconf-cargo wlanconf.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE wlanconf-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS xdk psdk)
